title: Credit for Cover Already Paid For on a Keyturn Guest Protection Plan Move of Level
content:
The credit for the cover already paid for follows how much of the cover has been used. The protection
already charged on the Keyturn Guest Protection Plan election is the protection fee charged for the trip, the
fee for every additional driver and the young-driver surcharge, less any protection fee returned against them.

1. Where cover is already running and the election covers 30 days or more, the credit is the protection already
   charged on the election spread evenly over the election's covered days and taken for the days still to run.
2. Where cover has not yet begun, the credit is the whole of the protection already charged on the election.
3. Where cover is already running and the election covers fewer than 30 days, the credit is the daily amount of
   the level first held for the days still to run.

## The three credits side by side

| Has cover begun? | Days of cover the election carries | The credit |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | 30 or more | The protection already charged, spread evenly over the covered days and taken for the days still to run |
| Yes | Fewer than 30 | The daily amount of the level first held, for the days still to run |
| No | Any number | The whole of the protection already charged |

## Worked on hypothetical elections

An election carrying 40 days of cover, with cover running, 1400.00 USD of protection fee charged, 20.00 USD
charged for an additional driver, 150.00 USD of young-driver surcharge and 70.00 USD returned, has 1500.00 USD
already charged. Spread evenly over the 40 covered days that is 37.50 USD for each day, and with 16 days still
to run the credit is 600.00 USD.

The same election with cover not yet begun gives a credit of the whole 1500.00 USD, whatever the days still to
run.

An election carrying 8 days of cover, with cover running, first held at a level whose daily amount is 26.00 USD
and with 5 days still to run, gives a credit of 130.00 USD, and what has actually been charged on the election
does not enter that figure.
